WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
), per_patient AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_of_patient_pt_averages,
       AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS average_of_patient_tat_difference_averages
FROM per_patient;
